name: Vice City
summary: The big city and the heart of the map: sun, money and excess, split into neighbourhoods such as Ocean Beach, Little Cuba and VC Port.
details: Rockstar's modern take on Miami, rebuilt and expanded since the 2002 game.
Neighbourhoods named so far: Ocean Beach with its art deco hotels and white sand, Little Cuba's panaderías, the Tisha-Wocka flea market, and VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world.
Other places named by Rockstar: Shore Drive, Washington Beach, Stockyard and Southside Vice City.
Flash FM is the city's pop institution.

name: Leonida Keys
summary: A tropical island chain at the edge of the state. Easygoing on land, with dangerous water all around it.
details: Leonida's version of the Florida Keys, where Jason works for local drug runners.
Brian Heder runs his boat yard here, and lets Jason live in one of his properties.
Reefs for scuba diving, with sharks, rays, turtles and jellyfish offshore.

name: Grassrivers
summary: Leonida's wetlands: mangroves, alligators and other wildlife you would rather not meet on foot.
details: Leonida's take on the Everglades: mangroves, swamps and alligators.
Airboats are the way to get around. Back Country Radio's reporter Mud Dog Mike broadcasts from one.

name: Port Gellhorn
summary: A former holiday coast in decline, now running on a rougher, drug-fuelled economy.
details: Stands in for Florida's struggling tourist-trap towns.
Expect abandoned attractions, cheap motels and run-down strip malls, on a rough, drug-fuelled economy.
Back Country Radio reaches out here too.

name: Ambrosia
summary: A town built around a sugar refinery, where a local biker gang has a say in how things run.
details: A town built around a sugar refinery.
A local biker gang has a big say in how things run.

name: Mount Kalaga National Park
summary: Wild country along Leonida's northern border: hunting, fishing and remote, isolated communities.
details: Wild country on the northern border with Gloriana, Leonida's take on the Florida–Georgia line.
Lumber industry and cleared forest, private-jet communities with their own airstrips, and struggling west-coast towns.
Built for the outdoors: ATV trails, mud parks, demolition derbies, mountain biking, farms, ranches, golf and bass fishing.
The Ultimate Edition's Dominator Buggy is made for these backwoods, and One-Eyed Willie's mod shop sits by Lake Leonida.
